units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:9:7">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>מקטוע כ׳</he> to cut thorns.
<cite ref="Shabbat 77b:8">Sabb. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>אכל כ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>בוצי</he>, <he>ביני</he>, Ar. <cite ref="B00660"><he>ביסי</he></cite>) (the camel) eats thorns.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 42b">B. Mets. 42ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>בכ׳ … דמי כ׳</he> (Ms. H. <cite ref="B00002"><he>ב׳</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6) when what he gave him in trust was thorns (on which the cuscuta was hanging), and he pays him the value of thorns.
